Title: 01. [UI/UX] Global Design System + IA Restructure + Page Templates (Light/Dark ready)
Body:
Goal
- Establish the global UI foundation for NivoStack Console to make every module consistent and fast to build.

Scope
- New Information Architecture (sidebar groups): Overview / Observe (Runtime) / Control / Operate / Developer / Organization
- Standard page template: Header (title/subtitle/CTA) + KPI strip (optional) + FilterBar + Content + DetailDrawer (optional)
- Define and implement design tokens usage across components (actual token implementation in separate ticket)

Acceptance Criteria
- Sidebar groups implemented, collapsible, active state, badge support (counts)
- Topbar implemented (sticky), supports: breadcrumb, environment selector, data-mode pill, global search (optional)
- At least 2 screens migrated to new template as proof (Devices + API Traces)

Title: 02. [UI/UX] Data UX Contract: Aggregated vs Raw vs Live (no conflict) + Drilldown Rules
Body:
Problem
- We must support both aggregated dashboards (fast) and raw row-by-row debugging (deep), without one replacing the other.

Requirements
- Add a global “Data Mode” convention + pill on pages:
  - Aggregated (dashboards)
  - Raw (lists/investigations)
  - Live (device debug streaming)
- Dashboard tiles MUST include:
  - Drilldown (aggregated detail)
  - View Raw (opens raw screen with filters prefilled)
- Define drilldown mapping standards:
  - Error-rate → API Traces (error=true, time range)
  - Crash spike → Crashes (group/version)
  - Drop-off → Sessions/Screen Flow (funnel step/screen)
- Live Debug entry points:
  - Device row action “Open Live Debug”
  - Alerts deep-links to Live Debug if device is debug-enabled

Acceptance Criteria
- Drilldown navigation carries filters consistently via URL params
- Raw pages show “Raw” mode label, dashboards show “Aggregated”, Live Debug shows “Live”

Title: 03. [UI/UX] Theme Tokens + Theme Toggle (Light/Dark/System) + Persist Setting
Body:
Scope
- Implement token-based theme system (CSS variables or Tailwind tokens)
- Toggle in topbar: Light / Dark / System
- Persist selection per user (preferred) or localStorage (fallback)

Acceptance Criteria
- All base surfaces/text/border/primary/status colors controlled by tokens
- Core components (buttons, cards, table, inputs) use tokens (no hard-coded colors)

Title: 04. [UI/UX] Reusable DataTable (server pagination/sort/columns/bulk/export + detail drawer hook)
Body:
Scope
- Build a shared DataTable component used by Devices, API Traces, Logs, Crashes, Localization Keys, etc.

Required features
- Server pagination + sorting + column chooser
- Row click opens DetailDrawer (configurable)
- Bulk actions (optional per screen)
- Export (CSV) action (optional per screen)
- Supports large datasets (virtualization optional, but avoid client-side huge renders)

Acceptance Criteria
- Devices and API Traces refactored to use the component

Title: 05. [UI/UX] Reusable FilterBar + More Filters Drawer + Saved Views + URL State
Body:
Scope
- Build a shared filter system to standardize filtering across raw/aggregated pages.

Required features
- Debounced search
- Quick filter chips + “More filters” drawer
- Filters reflected in URL query params
- Saved views (save, rename, set default) per user/project
- Clear all / reset to default

Acceptance Criteria
- Devices and API Traces migrated to FilterBar

Title: 06. [UI/UX] Projects List: search + filters + quick stats
Body:
From previous UI-001, updated for new IA.

Scope
- Projects list page with: search, status filters, quick stats per project (devices/sessions/requests last 24h)
- Quick action: open project, project settings, copy API key (permission gated)

Acceptance Criteria
- Server-side search and pagination
- Quick stats are aggregated (do not scan raw tables)

Title: 07. [UI/UX] Project Overview: make Overview default + add key health snapshot + drilldowns
Body:
From previous UI-003, updated to match Data Mode contract.

Scope
- On project open, land on Overview with:
  - Aggregated KPIs (requests, errors, crashes, active devices, cost)
  - Short trends
  - “View raw” actions that deep-link to raw pages with filters prefilled

Acceptance Criteria
- Overview reads from aggregates only
- Every tile supports View Raw

Title: 08. [UI/UX] Devices: Professional Device Management UI (segments + advanced filters + detail drawer)
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-004 + new Devices redesign.

UI Requirements
- Segments: Total / iOS / Android / Debug Enabled / Active Today / 7d / 30d
- Search: deviceId, deviceCode, userId/email, model, appVersion
- Filters: platform, appVersion, osVersion, manufacturer/model, country, carrier, language, status, registered range, lastSeen range
- Table columns default: Device, Platform, App, OS, Last Seen, Debug, Status
- Row click → Device Detail Drawer tabs:
  - Overview / Sessions / API Traces / Logs / Crashes / Metadata
- Row action: Open Live Debug
- Debug actions permission-gated

Performance Requirements
- Server pagination + debounced search
- No client-side loading of large lists

Title: 09. [UI/UX] Live Debug: near real-time raw feed for debug-enabled devices
Body:
New screen (Live Mode).

UI Requirements
- Device selector (pin devices) + copy deep-link
- Time window: 15m / 1h / 24h
- Tabs: API / Logs / Crashes / Screen Flow
- Streaming updates if available; fallback to polling every 3–5 seconds using since=lastTimestamp
- Show masking/redaction status + permission to reveal bodies (if allowed)

Acceptance Criteria
- Works for a single device without scanning large raw ranges
- Deep-linkable from Devices and Alerts

Title: 10. [UI/UX] API Traces: list + detail drawer + redaction controls + on-device debug context
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-005 + new API Traces redesign.

UI Requirements
- Columns: time, method, endpoint/url, status, duration, device, session, screenName, cost
- Filters: time range, endpoint, method, status class, error only, deviceId, sessionId, screenName, country/carrier/networkType
- Detail drawer tabs:
  - Summary (request metadata)
  - Headers
  - Body (masked by default; permission + project policy)
  - Related (logs, session timeline)
- Quick action: “Open in Live Debug” if debug enabled device

Performance Requirements
- Request/response bodies fetched lazily (on open), not in list query

Title: 11. [UI/UX] Logs: raw list + level/tag filters + sampling indicators
Body:
UI Requirements
- Columns: time, level, message, tag, device, session, screenName
- Filters: time range, level, tag, device, session, screen, contains search
- Detail drawer: full message + structured data json + file/line/function/class
- Show retention and sampling status (if applied)

Performance Requirements
- Server-side pagination + debounced search

Title: 12. [UI/UX] Crashes: grouping + versions + affected devices + drilldowns
Body:
UI Requirements
- Crash groups list: message/fingerprint, count, affected versions, first/last seen
- Filters: version, platform, time range, device, country
- Group detail: stacktrace, trends, impacted devices/sessions, related traces/logs
- “View raw” actions to underlying crash events

Performance Requirements
- Grouping uses aggregates; raw events only on drilldown

Title: 13. [UI/UX] Sessions & Screen Flow: session list + timeline + funnels entry
Body:
Scope
- Sessions list (raw) with filters: time range, device, version, entry/exit screen, duration, error count
- Session detail: screen timeline + correlated API traces/logs
- Provide drilldown links from dashboard drop-off/funnel insights

Performance Requirements
- Session list server paginated
- Timeline queries constrained by sessionId

Title: 14. [UI/UX] Business Config: table + categories + approvals + audit timeline
Body:
Scope
- Business Config keys list with inline edit (permission gated), categories, status enabled/disabled
- Change history timeline + approvals workflow entry (if enabled)
- Drilldown to usage analytics (aggregated reads)

Title: 15. [UI/UX] Localization Keys: table with inline edit + per-language quick view
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-006.

Scope
- Keys list with: key, description, category, platform, updatedAt
- Inline edit for metadata; translation edit in drawer/modal per language
- Bulk import/export
- Search + filters (category/platform/missing translations)

Performance Requirements
- Server-side pagination; no loading all keys

Title: 16. [UI/UX] Localization Statistics: coverage dashboard + missing keys drilldown
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-007.

Scope
- Aggregated view: translation coverage by language, missing keys by category, recent updates
- Drilldown: open raw keys list filtered to missing translations

Acceptance Criteria
- Uses aggregate queries / views only

Title: 17. [UI/UX] Builds / Versioning: builds list + snapshots + change log
Body:
Scope
- Builds list (preview/production), active indicator
- Build detail: business config snapshot + localization snapshot + change log (BuildChangeLog)
- Actions: promote preview->production, compare builds

Performance Requirements
- Snapshot loaded on demand; summary counts in list

Title: 18. [UI/UX] Alerts Center: API Alerts + Config Alerts + events + acknowledgement workflow
Body:
Scope
- Unified Alerts page: API alerts + Config alerts + events feed
- Filters: severity, status, time range, endpoint/config key
- Event detail: link to raw traces/logs/live debug when device is available
- Acknowledge + notes

Acceptance Criteria
- Alert event drilldown uses Data UX Contract

Title: 19. [UI/UX] SDK Settings: performance + privacy tabs (validation + preview)
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-008.

Scope
- Settings sections: batching/flush interval/queue sizes, masking rules, sensitive field patterns, min log level
- Validation and preview: show what will be masked
- Save confirmation and audit trail entry

Acceptance Criteria
- Includes guidance text and safe defaults

Title: 20. [UI/UX] Project Settings: rename + API key rotate + delete project (danger zone)
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-010 + UI-009 (danger actions).

Scope
- Project Settings: rename, environment, API keys rotate (permission gated)
- Danger Zone: delete project, purge data, reset keys (multi-confirmation)
- Audit log entry on each action

Acceptance Criteria
- Confirm modals, typed confirmation, re-auth requirement optional

Title: 21. [UI/UX] Org Analytics (multi-project): aggregated dashboard + drilldowns
Body:
Consolidates previous UI-002.

Scope
- Organization-level analytics across projects:
  - total devices/sessions/requests/errors/cost trends
  - top projects by errors/cost
- Drilldown opens specific project raw views with filters

Acceptance Criteria
- Aggregated only (no raw scans)

Title: 22. [DATA] Aggregation Layer v1: rollups/materialized views for dashboard KPIs
Body:
Goal
- Make dashboards fast and predictable by reading from aggregates, not raw events.

Scope (initial rollups)
- Per project + time bucket (hour/day):
  - active devices
  - sessions count
  - api requests count
  - error count / error rate
  - latency percentiles (p95/p99) if available
  - crash count
  - cost sum (from ApiTrace.cost)
- Provide query APIs to fetch dashboard tiles and trends

Acceptance Criteria
- Dashboard queries never scan ApiTrace/Log tables for charts
- Drilldown links route to raw views with filters prefilled

Title: 23. [DATA] Funnel/Drop-off Aggregations: session screen-flow derived metrics
Body:
Goal
- Support drop-off analytics without heavy raw scans.

Scope
- Build funnel metrics from Session.screenFlow (or derived events):
  - step counts, drop-off %, time between steps
- Provide drilldown mapping to raw sessions filtered by step/screen/time

Acceptance Criteria
- Funnel charts use aggregates; raw sessions only on drilldown

Title: 24. [DATA] “Recent Raw” optimized queries for Live Debug (fast by design)
Body:
Goal
- Make Live Debug safe/fast under load.

Scope
- Query patterns constrained by:
  - projectId + deviceId + timestamp range (15m/1h/24h max)
- Add or validate indexes:
  - ApiTrace(projectId, deviceId, timestamp desc)
  - Log(projectId, deviceId, timestamp desc)
  - Crash(projectId, deviceId, timestamp desc)
- Optional: separate storage policy/retention for raw tables

Acceptance Criteria
- Live Debug uses since=lastTimestamp to fetch deltas
